Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

CIRCULAR SCREWING DIES — GENERAL 
TABLE OF DIMENSIONS 



1. Scope — Covers the general dimensions of circular screwing dies. 

2. Types 

2.1 Type A — Adjustable circular screwing dies. 

2.2 Type B — Solid circular screwing dies. 

3. Dimensions — Shall be as given in Table 1 read with Fig. 1 . 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 

The requirements of thread cutting dies were earlier covered under IS : 1859-1961. IS : 1859 is 
being modified and replaced by a series of standards to include various requirements pertaining to 
screwing dies which have been felt necessary at the national and international level. The title of the 
standard is also being modified as 'Circular screwing dies' in place of Thread cutting dies' so as to 
bring it in line with the terminology agreed to at the international level. 

Other standards in the series are as follows: 

IS : 12320-1988 Technical supply conditions for circular screwing dies 

IS : 12321-1988 Circular screwing dies for ISO metric screw threads 

IS : 12322-1988 Circular screwing dies for taper pipe threads — R series 

IS : 12323-1988 Circular screwing dies for parallel pipe threads — G series 

IS : 12324-1988 Hexagonal die nuts 

IS : 12325-1988 Circular screw dies for ISO metric conduit pipe threads 

On the publication of above standards, IS : 1859 SN\\\ stand withdrawn. 

In the preparation of this standard, considerable assistanbe has been derived from: 

ISO 2568-1973 'Hand and machine-operated circular screwing dies and hand-operated 
die stocks', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( ISO ), and 

DIN 223 Teil 10-79 'Circular screwing dies: General table of dimensions', 'issued by the 
Deutsches Institut fiir Normung ( DIN ). 



Adopted 9 March 1988
